reason: My first question is always whether it is really tested, and here the lab is named and the report is tied to the batch number, so I can check it. At $24.99 for one box, with sachets I can throw in my bag when I travel, I would try it.
objection: Made in China. I want to actually open the report and see a real lab name and a matching batch before I believe it is not just marketing.
would_change_my_mind: If the QR report did not load or the batch number did not match, I would pass.
